hypothesis: Among working-age, digitally comfortable users in North America and Western Europe, economic motivation shifts how much people trust AI-generated recommendations: for the identical questionnaire, premium-seeking users report higher trust and adoption intent than cost-sensitive users.

factors.label: Economic motivation
factors.description: Persona attribute under test. Arms contrast on this attribute (a classification factor that cannot be randomly assigned); the environment is held constant via constants[]. Candidate pool eligibility lives in persona_strategy.json.
